title: 2017年 专八听力 考试

sections.title: SECTION A　MINI-LECTURE
lines: In this section, you will hear a mini-lecture.
You will hear the lecture ONCE ONLY.
While listening, please complete the gap-filling task on ANSWER SHEET ONE and write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS for each gap.
Make sure the word(s) you fill in is (are) both grammatically and semantically acceptable.
You may use the blank sheet for note taking.
You have THIRTY seconds to preview the gap-filling task.
When it is over, you will be given THREE minutes to check your work.

sections.title: SECTION B　INTERVIEW
lines: In this section you will hear TWO interviews.
At the end of each interview, five questions will be asked about what was said.
Both the interviews and the questions will be spoken ONCE ONLY.
After each question there will be a ten-second pause.
During the pause, you should read the four choices of A, B, C and D, and mark the best answer to each question on ANSWER SHEET TWO.
You have THIRTY seconds to preview the choices.
